description: Find FDIC-insured banks by name, state or city, in a given quarter (default: latest). Name matching ignores case and punctuation and drops the words 'national association', 'bank', 'the' and 'N.A.', so 'JPMorgan' finds JPMORGAN CHASE BANK, NATIONAL ASSOCIATION; partial names work. Results are ranked: match = exact, starts_with, contains, then larger assets first. Each row has 'ambiguous': true when several different banks fit the name; in that case ask the user which one (use city and state to tell them apart) rather than picking the first. A bank that merged or closed before the quarter does not appear in it; when nothing matches the quarter, the search falls back to history and returns rows with match = former_or_closed and the bank's last reported quarter. If nothing matches at all, one row with 'no_match' explains why. Returns cert, name, city, state, total assets. Use the returned cert in bank_quarter_income, bank_metric_series and bank_peer_compare. Domestic FDIC-insured filers, 2018-03 to 2026-06.
name: find_bank
